title: Light Norteño Pibil Pibil
description: A quick and easy vegan take on the classic Yucatecan cochinita pibil dish, featuring tender jackfruit and a tangy citrus marinade.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine lime and orange juice, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Heat the vegan butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped jalapeño and cook for an additional minute.
Add the jackfruit to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, until tender and lightly browned.
Transfer the jackfruit mixture to a baking dish and brush with the citrus marinade.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, until the jackfruit is tender and the glaze is set.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as rice, beans, or tortillas.
Adjust the level of heat to your liking by adding more or less jalapeño.
For a crisper glaze, broil the jackfruit for an additional 2-3 minutes, watching carefully to avoid burning.
